title: The Family Support Circle
learning_focus: Value of family and trusted support in adolescent sexual and reproductive health concerns, especially early-pregnancy prevention.
story_premise: A fictional adolescent is afraid to ask for help because each family member assumes someone else will listen.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Value of family and trusted support in adolescent sexual and reproductive health concerns, especially early-pregnancy prevention.

areas.title: Listening Circle
areas.story: Choose calm, respectful, non-shaming responses. Discuss expectations and goals without threats or humiliation.
